title: Risks: labor, copycats, legal, open questions
summary: Price floors, copycats, trademarks, fair pay, QC at scale, registration/tax/disclosure, and ownership/cost questions still open.

blocks.title: Name the hard parts early
blocks.body: This page is the honesty shelf. An idea page that skips risks becomes a pitch. Keep these visible while you roll out.

items.label: Labor time / price floor
items.detail: Minutes per heart set the minimum honest price. Ignore this and either you or assemblers eat the loss.

items.label: Copycats
items.detail: Rings are commodity. Edge is community, fresh designs, and speed of content — not secrecy of pliers.

items.label: Trademarks
items.detail: Custom logos need permission. Fan marks and school crests are not free clip art.

items.label: Fair assembler pay
items.detail: Piece rates must clear a living-effective hourly after QC rejects.

items.label: QC at scale
items.detail: More builders means more variance. Badges and sample pulls are mandatory, not nice-to-have.

items.label: Legal basics
items.detail: Business registration, sales tax, contractor vs employee questions, affiliate disclosure on posts.

items.label: ☐ Who owns what
items.detail: Maker vs platform vs content rights for photos, patterns, and member gallery posts.

items.label: ☐ Ring cost vs heart sell price
items.detail: Unit economics per hero SKU, including waste, shipping, and payment fees.

blocks.heading: Default mitigations
items: Publish time studies before opening paid assembly.
Require written logo permission on every custom job.
Keep affiliate terms product-only; audit recruiting-shaped talk.
Revisit ownership and unit economics before Phase 5 scale.

blocks.title: Back to the front door
blocks.body: Risks do not kill the idea — they set the pace. Return to Chainmail Collective for the map, or to Rollout for the next proof gate.
